title: Azeroth (disambiguation)
wikitext:
Throughout the ''Warcraft'' universe sources, the term '''Azeroth''' is used to describe several things:

*'''[[Azeroth|Azeroth, the world]]''' - The name of the planet where most of the action of ''World of Warcraft'' takes place.
*'''[[Stormwind (kingdom)|Azeroth, the kingdom]]''' - One of the [[Seven Kingdoms]], also called the Kingdom of Stormwind.
*'''[[Azeroth (continent)|Azeroth, the continent]]''' - One of the three continents that comprise the [[Eastern Kingdoms]].<ref>[http://web.archive.org/web/20030210065238/http://www.battle.net:80/war3/orc/ Archived page]</ref>
*'''[[Eastern Kingdoms]]''' - In some sources the term "Azeroth" is used interchangeable with the Eastern Kingdoms.<ref>{{Alliance}} [40] [[Dark Council]]</ref><ref>''[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Game_Manual#Trolls World of Warcraft: Game Manual#Trolls]''</ref>
